title: Area and Perimeter of Squares, Rectangles and Triangles
seo_title: Grade 7 Area and Perimeter Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade 7: 4.1 Area and perimeter of 2D shapes
standard_text: Use appropriate formulae to calculate perimeter of polygons and area of squares, rectangles and triangles; describe the interrelationship between perimeter and area; convert between mm², cm² and m².
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 7 area and perimeter worksheets: area of rectangles and triangles, perimeter, composite shapes and missing lengths. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Perimeter is the distance around a shape. Area is the space inside it.
  • Rectangle: A = l × b. Square: A = l².
  • Triangle: A = 12 × base × perpendicular height.
  • Split composite shapes into rectangles and triangles.

Examples

Example

A triangle with base 12 cm and height 7 cm

½ × 12 × 7

Answer: 42 cm²

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting ½A triangle is half a rectangle.
The slant sideUse the perpendicular height.
Area or perimeter?Area is in cm²; perimeter in cm.
